programmes.d: Destination is Lindbergh' Reindeer Lake Lodge in northern Saskatchewan. If you have ever dreamed of catching Pike until your arms hurt, and some of them true monsters, this is your destination. Learn a few tricks and hang on!

programmes.d: This episode starts in Kissimmee Florida, then out in Lake Ontario for early Salmon. Fishing during cold fronts can be challenging, but a few tricks will keep the rods bent and the fish hitting.

programmes.d: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programmes.d: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.
Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

New Zealand's Southland's four major rivers are famous as brown trout fisheries, especially in the upper and middle sections, but in this episode Anto Hall and Mike Wilkinson are heading to the estuaries, to fish the annual smelt run.

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: Golden Bay Kingfish
programmes.d: Discovering new waters to fish is among the pinnacles of the fly fishing experience, and this saltwater flats fishery, Golden Bay, is just such a gem. Kingfish have a unique relationship with short-tailed stingrays, which they use as mobile cover.

This episode of Pure Fly NZ sees a helicopter ride take anglers Cory Scott and Chris Charland deep into the the mountains to target New Zealand's famous trophy trout, but will an approaching weather-bomb cause them a headache.
Lake Taupo was formed in the caldera caused by an enormous volcanic explosion. The Tauranga is one of the few tributaries that the lake's legendary rainbow trout use to spawn.
The South Island's Otago Lakes District is the location for remarkable autumn trout fishing brought about by the fish leaving the lakes and heading upstream to spawn.
